title: Activation Request v1
description: LIVE as of Phase 6, gated behind OWNER_EXTERNAL_API_ENABLED=false by default. Matches app/licensing_service/activation.py::REQUIRED_FIELDS exactly.

timestamp.description: Timezone-aware ISO-8601. Must be within OWNER_ACTIVATION_TIMESTAMP_SKEW_SECONDS of server time.

installation_id.description: Client-generated local identifier. The server response returns a DIFFERENT, server-assigned installation_id to use for all future calls.

device_public_key.description: base64 of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key.

license_key.description: The full plaintext license key -- this request only. Never persisted, logged, or returned. See owner-license-key-design.md and external-api-forbidden-data-report.md.

idempotency_key.description: Same key on a legitimate retry -> identical logical result, no extra device slot consumed.

signature.description: base64 Ed25519 signature over the canonical form (app/licensing_service/canonical.py) of every other field in this object.
